adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff around line 554 in packages/core/EventManager.ts, when merging bookings (newBookingId case), the code still uses `.find()` to get only the first calendar reference: `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes('_calendar'))`. However, the rest of the code has been refactored to handle multiple calendar references using `.filter()` (as seen in the calendarReference variable which is now an array). This inconsistency means that when merging seat bookings, only the first old calendar event gets deleted while other collective-host calendar events remain orphaned. This is a real bug introduced by the incomplete refactoring.
